USB 2.0 Length Matching

The file `/home/user/Desktop/board.kicad_pcb` has USB 2.0 D+ (`USB_DP`) and D- (`USB_DM`) routed on F.Cu at 0.15 mm width. Their lengths differ by approximately 1 mm, exceeding the USB 2.0 intra-pair skew budget.

Add a meander on the shorter differential net (D-) until `|L(USB_DP) - L(USB_DM)| <= 0.15 mm`. Preserve layer assignments (F.Cu only), track widths (0.15 mm), and introduce no new vias.

Requirements:
1. `|L(USB_DP) - L(USB_DM)| <= 0.15 mm`.
2. Both nets have segments only on F.Cu; no layer changes.
3. All `USB_DP` and `USB_DM` segment widths remain 0.15 mm.
4. No new vias added on `USB_DP` or `USB_DM` vs the input.
5. `USB_DM` has more segments than the input (meander increases segment count).
6. Also write `/home/user/Desktop/fcu.svg` as the native KiCad CLI F.Cu SVG export of your final board.

Write /home/user/Desktop/board.kicad_pcb and /home/user/Desktop/fcu.svg.
source: USB 2.0 Specification and USB-C R2.1 (USB 2.0 2.7.5 intra-pair skew <= 100 ps), KiCad 9 Official Documentation - PCB Editor / CLI (`kicad-cli pcb export svg`)
